brief.headline: Blackstone Provides $310M Bridge Loan for Nashville Mixed-Use Tower
bullets: Infrastructure & Energy: A joint venture among PGIM, Stiles Corporation and Hensler Development has secured $310 million to refinance Peabody Union, a 665,000-square-foot office and residential development in Downtown Nashville, Tenn., according to JLL.
Private Credit: Blackstone announced the final close of Blackstone European Senior Direct Lending Fund IV, or BXDE IV.
Exits & Secondaries: The alternative asset manager reportedly generated distributable earnings of $1.12 per share for the three months to September, exceeding analysts' expectations of $1.

Real Estate: Starwood Capital Group and Trinitas Ventures have secured $100.3 million in construction financing to build Atmosphere Pittsburgh, a 672-bed student housing property near the University of Pittsburgh, Commercial Observer can first report.

M&A & Buyouts: Cinven has agreed to acquire women's healthcare specialist Theramex from Carlyle and PAI Partners in a transaction valued at approximately €2.6bn, almost double the €1.4bn paid by the sellers four years earlier, according to a report by the Financial Times.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,353.73 (down 4.4% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 28.2, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.90% (down 5 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.38 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.48%, near long-run norms (up 16 bps on the prior reading).
